detail: Updates - ArMee Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )   regarding non-execution of theBondada EPC Project forming part of the order book disclosed in the Red Herring Prospectus'.
